thread:
Dana (Support): FYI escalating OrthoHealth trial — onboarding hit repeated provisioning failures across their dedicated trial pool. Ingestion jobs timed out, inference requests getting 503s. Exec sync with their CTO next Wed, customer flagged renewal risk if not resolved quickly. Please triage + comms plan.
Marco (CSM): Thanks Dana — assigning to CS. I'll own external comms. Can you drop the most recent logs and repro steps here? Also what's the trial quota and config they used?
Dana (Support): Repro steps pasted below. Logs show `ERROR: kube-provision timeout after 120s` and repeated `503 gateway` from the inference routing layer. They used reserved trial capacity 2xA10G, custom VPC, token-auth.
Sara (Eng): Looking at logs — sounds like autoscaler failing to attach GPUs during heavy ingest. Quick ask: can you share the exact job payload? If available paste the manifest.
Dana (Support): Manifest snippet: ```yaml
job: batch-ingest
image: rh-inference:stable
replicas: 4
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
Also saw many `kv-cache OOM` warnings.
Marco (CSM): Ok. Leah — can you prep a comms plan? We need a proactive note to OrthoHealth execs + an internal RCA ticket and a proposed timeline to mitigate before Wed.
Leah (CSM): On it. Draft plan: 1) Immediate: notify customer we're prioritizing with dedicated war room + ask for narrow maintenance window tonight (1hr). 2) Today (within 4h): engineering to attempt safe restart of provisioner on their trial pool, enable fallback routing to hosted model for read-only queries. 3) Tomorrow: full ingest replay once kv-cache tuning applied. 4) Before Wed: confirm stability and send exec email including mitigations + SLA credits offer if still degraded. I'll draft templates.
Marco (CSM): Perfect. Add owner names/times and preferred contact lines. I'll lead the exec email.
Sara (Eng): I'll be on the war room. Quick mitigation steps I want to try now: 
- scale down replicas to 2 to reduce attach load
- temporarily disable prefix caching to avoid kv-cache OOMs
- force a graceful restart of the provisioner pod `kubectl rollout restart deploy/provisioner`
I'll update here after each step.
Dana (Support): Ops-bot created incident INC-2026-234 for this thread.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-234 created by Dana (Support) severity=P2 components=[provisioner, inference-router] link=https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-234
Marco (CSM): Comms checklist I'm adding to the ticket: short status update (30m), detailed technical timeline for eng (3h), exec note draft (6h), customer-facing FAQ for their SREs.
Leah (CSM): Draft exec note (short): "We're actively prioritizing your onboarding issue — dedicated war room opened, mitigation steps underway, we'll provide hourly updates and confirm recovery before your meeting. Marco will send a tailored exec update this afternoon." Thoughts?
Marco (CSM): Good. Add concrete ETA: first update within 1h.
Sara (Eng): Update 1: scaled replicas -> 2. Observed fewer attach errors but one pending `nodeSelector` mismatch on one pod. Will fix node labels and reattempt attach.
Dana (Support): Customer notified of war room and 1hr window. They responded :thumbsup: and asked for Slack channel for direct updates.
Leah (CSM): I'll set up a dedicated DM thread with their SRE + send the first hourly note after your next status, Marco.
Marco (CSM): Assigning tasks: Sara -> mitigation steps and timeline (eng lead). Dana -> collect detailed logs and maintain timeline. Leah -> external comms + exec note. I'll coordinate.
Sara (Eng): Update 2: fixed node label, reattached GPU to pod, provisioner restarted. Inference router now returning 200 for test calls to the fallback path. Still validating ingest replay integrity.
Dana (Support): Adding a note to INC-2026-234: `customer_pending_confirm` after our test call.
Leah (CSM): I'll draft the first hourly status and post to customer's SRE Slack and to this thread for record.
Marco (CSM): Thanks team — let's keep updates short and actionable. If we hit a blocker escalate to P1 and loop in infra oncall.
Dana (Support): Will do.
Sara (Eng): Will follow up in 20m with ingest replay results.
Leah (CSM): Posting exec email draft to the ticket now for review.
Marco (CSM): Reviewed, looks good. Sending after Leah finalizes tone.
Leah (CSM): Sent exec note at 2026-03-18T15:43Z, customer replied appreciative and booked follow-up demo. Marking this as high-priority handoff complete; retention risk reduced. :white_check_mark:
